top_choice_rationale: The HPV virus-like-particle vaccine proposal most convincingly combines a bounded, mature biological achievement with durable population-level prevention of HPV infection and associated cancers. Although its wider translational history exceeds three laureates, the proposed trio is a sufficiently coherent representation when credit is confined to the VLP vaccine advance.
recusal_note: No apparent conflict with the proposed laureates from the supplied profile. Documented coauthorship with Vijay Kuchroo and Sven-Erik Sonesson does not identify a connection to the proposed candidates.
